title: Rav Natan bar Avin

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Chullin 45b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.45b.15): he sat before Rav and examined whether the greater part of the spinal membrane and the greater part of the cord tissue were intact. Rav told him, “If most of its membrane is intact, this cord tissue makes no difference,” etc. Hyman states that the name should actually read Rav Natan bar Abba, as cited in Dikdukei Soferim, note 3 there.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2747&lang=en) give Rav Natan bar Avin. Hyman prefers bar Abba on the basis of the apparatus he cites.

The discussion concerns the spinal membrane and cord tissue. לא מעלה in this abbreviated quotation means that the tissue’s condition makes no difference when most of the membrane remains intact; it does not mean that the tissue independently makes the animal fit.
